```json
 ],
 "topology": "Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS output, Rz-nulled Cc)",
 "rationale": "The 20 uW limit allows about 11 uA total. Budget: 1 uA reference, 2 uA tail and 6 uA output stage gives about 16 uW. Two gain stages give about 70-75 dB. GBW = gm1/Cc is set near 1.3 MHz. The output pole needs gm7 of about 85 uS (gm7/(2*pi*CL) is about 2.7 MHz). Rz of about 2/gm7 adds a LHP zero for PM of 60 degrees or more. M7 copies the load gm/Id and L to null systematic offset. The NMOS input suits VCM = 0.9 V."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.5),       # input pair L
    "gmidp": (13.0, 8.0, 15.5),      # PMOS load / output device gm/Id (same -> no systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # PMOS load / output L
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "kt":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # tail = kt * iref
    "k7":    (6.0, 3.5, 7.5),        # output current = k7 * iref
    "Cc":    (1.8e-12, 0.8e-12, 4e-12),
    "rzk":   (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # Rz = rzk / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 1e-6)
    Itail = p["kt"] * iref
    I7 = p["k7"] * iref
    gmid_n = 10.0

    # bias: diode sink of reference, tail and output sinks mirrored (same L, gm/Id)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=mref.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Itail / 2, vds=1.0)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Itail / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    # PMOS CS output (same density as load -> Vsg match)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Rz = p["rzk"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # reference
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # first stage: vinn on diode side, vinp on output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n2", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n2", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    # compensation
    n.C("CC", "n2", "cz", Cc)
    n.R("RZ", "cz", "vout", Rz)

    # analytic predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + C1 * CL + Cc * CL))
    denom = (Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * denom) if denom > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1) if C1 > 0 else 1e15
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    power = spec.get("vdd", 1.8) * (iref + Itail + I7)
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}
```
